Community participation and partnerships

Help strengthen the Franklin community platform.

Franklin Navigator is building relationships with local organizations, event partners and people who can help residents and community members use the platform well.

Email community participation interest
Built for Franklin

Not a national directory with a Franklin label. Profiles, local tools, participation paths and membership are organized around the Franklin community itself.

  • Free factual profile review and corrections
  • Clear local participation tools
  • Simple Community Membership choices
Community events

Pop-ups and local gatherings

Help residents and organizations discover profiles, local tools, participation paths and free correction options at appropriate Franklin events.

Partnerships

Organizations and institutions

Explore responsible collaborations, resource sharing, help keeping community information up to date, workshops or community information projects without implying endorsement.

Requested high-touch help

Community ambassadors

Provide friendly, accurate guidance when an organization asks for in-person help reviewing a profile or understanding Community Membership.

Digital-first routine participation

Most profile review, member preview, onboarding and support should work online. Ambassadors are primarily for community presence, events, partnerships and requested help—not pressure-based selling.

Clear boundaries

  • No guaranteed selection, work or compensation
  • No claim of employment or contractor status before a written agreement
  • No false affiliation with government, nonprofits or listed organizations
  • We do not treat a public email address as permission to contact someone
